label: Act is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to POTENCY_2 at a first being, from esse-cause priority
meaning: The first-being version of act priority from the same four premises: by firstBeingNoPotencyOfEssePriority a first being is in potency in no respect, so the first-being version holds vacuously. The sibling of weakOfComposition without the cause-to-efficient-cause bridge and efficient-cause priority. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.

strong_version_needed.3d99779b-b44a-4daa-a873-8ccdd3c034ae: As in weakOfComposition: the route takes act in some respect (STMT 8288ff1e), not act in being; the restriction to act in being suffices with STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING, which this route does not assume.
